_doc: Proposed zero-liquid-discharge common effluent treatment plants for textile dyeing units in Namakkal district, rows 8 and 9 of the table the Tamil Nadu Department of Textiles prints on its 'Nadanthai Vaazhi Cauvery' page (under the heading 'NAMAKKAL DISTRICT').

Rows are parsed from the page's HTML table by script, not typed; the page saved 2026-10-21 and the copy saved 2026-09-18 by the Erode research give identical rows. registerUnitId joins each scheme to the company of the same name on the TNGIS industry register; that join is by name and is the part to review.

Green Environmental Association (R21KMP40221207, type 1078, common treatment facility) is on the treatment-plants layer and joins in build_industries. Kumarapalayam Green Kavery Dyeing Cluster (R21KMP37204277) is registered as type 1079, an industrial park ('TEXTILE PARK WITH CETP'), so it is on the industries layer (red-other) and the plant join does not reach it.

Costs are in Rs crore as printed. The page states the proposal for 75% of the revised total of Rs.1885.25 crore for 10 CETPs (8 in Erode district, 2 in Namakkal) was submitted on 13.03.2023 and a further request made on 09.08.2023.
existingPlants is empty: TNPCB's 2020 list of operating textile CETPs (tnpcb.gov.in/cept.php, Textile2020.pdf, 19 rows) names no plant at a Namakkal place.
